rationale: Describes managing third-party and Microsoft software patches across servers and workstations, including reporting and deployment through WSUS or SCCM; these are conventional systems-management functions.
evidence_spans: perform 3rd-party patch management across tens of thousands of servers and workstations, and enables you to leverage and extend the capabilities of Microsoft WSUS or SCCM to report, deploy, and manage 3rd-party patches as well as Microsoft patches.
